description: Edition 5 of Parleshwar Katta (Nov 2026), from the Rotary Club of Mumbai Parleshwar, brings readers a festive issue that informs, inspires and serves. Reflections on Diwali then and now and the Karva Chauth story keep our traditions alive for younger generations. Features on Talgad and Murud-Janjira forts celebrate Maharashtra’s heritage, while pieces on money lessons, business resilience and guilt-free festive eating offer practical guidance for everyday life. The Rotary Impact section shows service in action: a Dental & Eye Health Camp screened 1,444 school students, including children with autism, with treatment at subsidised rates, and the club co-hosted the Interact District Conference, where ~500 young leaders took the Nasha Mukt Bharat pledge against addiction. Read it, share it, and join us at Culture Fest on 12–13 Dec at Hedgewar Ground, Vile Parle East.
